title: Outfit Cards → Dex Asset Card Pipe
description: Transforms outfit & cosmetic modifier JSON cards from content/cards/outfits/ into Dex wardobe assets with elemental affinity bindings.
acceptance: Validates all outfit cards against schemas/outfit_card.schema.json
Maps elements (void, fire, water, aether) and rarity tiers (R, SR, SSR, UR)
Ensures multiplier curves are bounded and positive
